common_prefix.harness_choice: highest native selection accuracy among eight frozen E15 proposals and no-patch, subject to the same promotion floor
common_prefix.accounting: Both arms inherit the same validated prefix. Charge its full original training/search, including discarded step31; do not present this as fresh independent E0 restarts.

h2.engineer_promotion_metric: mean over eight proposals, each scored with two Solver samples per task
h2.harness_promotion_candidates: incumbent harness, no-patch, and all eight proposals of the selected Engineer checkpoint
h2.unchanged_solver_packets: reuse frozen W0 training evidence with unchanged serving/reward protocol
h2.changed_solver_packets: fresh official greedy baseline on legacy train0-239; compact with the same frozen builder settings

ma.reason_fresh_only: Correct terminal mode requires complete fresh trajectories; do not silently reenable legacy replay with nonterminal bootstrapping.

optimizer_handoff: Carry selected actor and same-role critic weights; reset Adam moments at identical H/W phase counts in both arms.
stop_interpretation: Bounded strong continuation; a budget stop is not evidence of convergence. Do not compare against the historical two-update arms.
